full_prompt_en: A square watercolor and ink cartoon places a stout white-bearded adventurer at the center of an otherwise pale blank page. He has a large pink nose, bushy eyebrows, a wide grin, and a patterned cap with protruding rounded objects and a trailing red cloth. A purple-brown jacket hangs over a pale green patched shirt and a dark belt crowded with small pouches and tools. His legs are short and planted wide in heavy brown boots. In his raised right hand he holds a thin upright sword or pointed tool, while his other hand lifts a small object near the left side of his body. Around his feet is a loose circle of odd little companions. A pink frog-like figure with bulging eyes crouches at the lower left; a green round creature with a wide mouth and small limbs occupies the lower center; and an orange spotted fox-like animal stands at the right with one paw raised and a broad toothy smile. A few darker brown and gray shapes nestle between them. The group sits over sparse gray ground strokes and tiny pebbles, with no detailed landscape. A pale blue rectangular wash behind them ends before the page margins, leaving an uneven white border visible. Fine black pen lines define faces, cloth seams, fur, and pebbles, while loose translucent washes of rose, olive, ocher, and blue-gray provide color. Soft even light is implied by the white paper, with light underfoot shadows only. The composition feels bustling and humorous, yet its open page border keeps the cluster of expressive shapes clearly contained.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩墨线漫画把一个身形敦实的白胡子冒险者放在几乎空白的浅色纸页中央。他有大粉鼻、浓眉、宽笑容，戴一顶带凸出圆件和垂下红布的花纹帽。紫棕外套罩着浅绿补丁上衣，深腰带挂满小袋和工具。腿短而站得宽，脚穿沉重棕靴。他举起的右手握一把细长直立的剑或尖工具，另一只手在身体左侧举着小物件。脚边松散围着一圈奇异小伙伴。左下粉色蛙状角色鼓眼蹲着；下方中央绿色圆身生物张着宽嘴、长着小肢；右边橘色斑点狐状动物举起一只爪，露出宽阔的露齿笑容。其间还挤着少量深棕与灰色小形状。全组落在稀疏灰色地面笔痕和细小石粒上，没有细密风景。身后浅蓝矩形淡洗在页边之前结束，留下不整齐白边。细黑钢笔线刻出面孔、衣缝、皮毛和石子，玫瑰色、橄榄色、赭黄与蓝灰的松散半透明水彩洗色提供颜色。白纸暗示柔和均匀的光，只有脚边轻影。构图忙碌幽默，但敞开的纸页边缘使富表情的形状群保持清楚围合。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor-and-ink illustration uses lively fine black contours, quick hatching, and transparent uneven washes over visible white paper. Exaggerate facial features and proportions through rounded silhouettes, expressive gestures, and small offbeat details. Color with rose pink, warm ocher, olive green, muted purple, and blue-gray, letting pigment pool gently in recesses instead of filling every shape evenly. Keep a dense central cluster over sparse grounding marks and leave an irregular wide blank margin. Loose linework can describe texture and movement while still keeping each overlapping form readable. Illumination is flat and paper-bright, with only mild local shadows. The transferable effect is comic, warm, and improvisational, achieved through crowded characterful detail against open space and the interplay of crisp pen with soft wash.
style_prompt_zh: 水彩墨线插画在可见白纸上使用活跃纤细黑轮廓、快捷排线与透明而不均匀的洗色。通过圆润剪影、富表情动作和古怪小细节夸大面部特征与比例。以玫瑰粉、暖赭、橄榄绿、柔紫和蓝灰上色，让颜料在凹处轻微积聚，而非每块都均匀填满。中央形状群密集，地面笔痕稀少，四周留宽而不整齐的空白页边。松散线条可描摹纹理与动作，同时让重叠形状各自可读。照明平坦且像亮纸，仅有轻微局部影子。可迁移的效果滑稽、温暖而即兴，来自开放空间前拥挤的鲜明细节，以及清晰钢笔线与柔软洗色的配合。
theme_en: A cheerful bearded adventurer with little creatures on a bare page
theme_zh: 一位欢快的白胡子冒险者与小怪物站在空白纸面上
name: Sergio Aragones
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
